notes: Access: direct HTTP fetch worked throughout (Shopify store, no WAF/challenge), consistent with prior Home-Decor pass notes for this company. Discovery: enumerated all 95 entries from /collections.json and keyword-matched title against best/sell/new/arriv/sale/clear/outlet/popular/trend/latest/recent - found handles 'best-seller' and 'top-selling' as bestseller-type candidates (no 'Customer Favorites', 'Trending Products' or 'Popular Products' handle exists on this site). Both are linked from the homepage (best-seller x3, top-selling x1 occurrences in homepage HTML) confirming they are live merchandising pages, not orphaned collections. Both opened and confirmed as real browsable Shopify collection PLPs (standard product grid template, not editorial). Alias check: compared full title sets of both collections - only 198 of 573 best-seller titles also appear in top-selling's 234 titles (375 titles unique to best-seller, 36 unique to top-selling) - genuinely different listings with different totals, not aliases of the same page, so both kept as separate rows per brief section 3. Qty method: raw collections/<handle>.json 'products_count' field is known-inflated on this site's Shopify backend (confirmed in the prior Home-Decor pass for regular categories, e.g. pendant-lights raw=174 vs exhaustive=119); used the same exhaustive method here - paged /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 to exhaustion and deduped by product id. best-seller: raw field=799 vs exhaustive=573 (3 pages: 250+250+73, sum matched dedup count exactly, no duplicate ids across pages). top-selling: raw field=372 vs exhaustive=234.

rows.evidence: Exhaustive paging of /collections/best-seller/products.json?limit=250 across 3 pages (250+250+73=573 unique product ids, no duplicates); raw collections/best-seller.json 'products_count' field reported 799 (inflated - not used)
Exhaustive paging of /collections/top-selling/products.json?limit=250 (234 unique product ids); raw collections/top-selling.json 'products_count' field reported 372 (inflated - not used)
